notes.title: REWRITING THE GAME
notes.notes:
This game is 3 years old, and in the meantime I've improved a lot into making games, with a nicer quality.
That's why I'll completely rewrite a new version of the game.
This will mean also a complete restyle. Hope a crispy and nice pixel art is good
for everyone!
The new version will overwrite the old one! So no need to pay more!
I just want to repair this game once for all. No more crashes, no more lag,
full and nice controller support. A decent menu, a cooler gameplay and nicer animations...
AND..
MORE BLOOD!

notes.title: Game Pad Update
notes.notes:
Connect an xbox controller.

Left stick = move
Right stick = aim
Rshoulder = shoot
Lshoulder = granade
A button = Buy weapon
